There are a number of non-trivial behavior differences between webpack and Turbopack that are important to be aware of when migrating an application. Generally, these are less of a concern for new applications.
Turbopack uses the root directory to resolve modules. Files outside of the project root are not resolved.
For example, linked dependencies outside the project root (via
, etc.) are not resolved by default. Configure
when your application directly imports files outside the detected root rather than reaching them through symlinks.

This can lead to subtle rendering changes when adopting Turbopack, if applications have come to rely on an arbitrary ordering. Generally, the solution is easy, e.g. have
